scope: Source, selector/property ownership, optional complete baseline byte comparison, and conservative sRGB compositing. Not live CSSOM, mobile rendering, hit-testing or physical Android validation.

results.name: Identical index and nero entry points
Exactly one new personal-centre owner
Uses the existing controls layer after r1029 paint and before legacy contracts
Only five explicitly panel-owned paint rules
Every selector requires the visible Ambiyans tab and direct dashboard child
No blanket card, scene, introduction, wheel, player or other panel selector
Only background, border colour, shadow and text colour can change
No layout, visibility, animation, pointer, filter, opacity or font mutation
Outer panel uses a single modest translucent gradient
Outer tint keeps 45–55% of scene light visible
Existing border thickness is retained with a more visible 42% tint
Reflection is static and inset, with no new overlay element
Only the four dashboard text containers receive local scrims
Muted text is explicit and active status keeps its state colour
Reduced-transparency preference has a narrow near-opaque fallback
r1029 no-blur dashboard contract remains present
The labelled panel remains owned by dashCreate with original native controls
Simple and Focus dashboard visibility rules remain owned by existing CSS
Small dashboard labels exceed 4.5:1 on a white scene
Headings, values and control text exceed 4.5:1 on a white scene
Reduced-transparency fallback exceeds 4.5:1 without relying on inner scrims
